result:
I recall a distant, misty evening when the sun dipped beneath the horizon, its last rays painting the sky in hues of fire as they kissed the serene sea goodbye. I was walking along a solitary beach, my thoughts wandering aimlessly like ships lost at sea. The rhythmic lap of waves against the sand seemed to whisper stories of times long past and futures yet unwritten, moving in harmony with the smoky cadence of the setting sun. In this moment of solitude, I felt an urgent need to answer the universe's silent questions. With each grain of sand that danced beneath my feet, my fingers trembled with the anticipation of uncovering secrets buried deep within the whispers of the tides. My heart was an open book, pages fluttering against the wind’s breath, uncertain whether to partake in the stories of solitude or fortune. The amber glow slightly dimming, my stomach hummed with the contentment of rest and contemplation, simultaneously dancing with destiny's uncertainty. It felt as if the destiny of both the sands and I were under the same vast, expectant sky. Without a sound, the wind had begun to sing, its chorus tuning into the melody of the cosmos, a symphony that I had always aspired to understand.

How profoundly absurd that I would seek wisdom in ephemeral elements. Yet, astonishingly, I found myself seduced by the beauty of transience, the poetry in the rhythm of life. Each grain of sand, it whispered of revolutions spanning ages, of mountains, of empires fallen; history's carryings-on, etched in each particle, yet ultimately inconsequential to the wild goose-chasing the air currents. A prevailing sentiment struck me then – in the pursuit of existence's great tapestry, we were but the loom and thread. A transient glimmer in the vast expanse of time. Here, surrounded by the ephemeral beauty of the ocean, I was merely another fleeting speck, a story written not just on the fragile surface but in the crinkling cortex of existence. It made me realize that sometimes it was the most profound wisdom to marvel at the vastness, at the vastness and our infinitesimal imprint.

The beach was not an escape but a revelation, echoed in the silence of an encroaching dusk. The symphony of waves relevantly transforming, just as humans, continuously evolving. The ceaseless ladder of events towering millennia above my solitary being - validating yet humbling my minuscule existence. From the personal perspective, it was maddening, yet elemental to seek alignment with the larger whole, a personal need to embrace each moment. Grasping sand grains in my palm, they slipped back into the tide, highlighting lessons in impermanence, a testament to cycles. I sighed, comprehending that all of us, in the grand orbit of life, were both the artist and canvas. It left me with a singular truth - existence was not a race but a delicate dance of the chosen steps. A candid exchange I had with my identity, accepting my intricate yet simple role in life's relentless flow. Here, in that hauntingly beautiful amplitude, an overarching connectedness was born.

Yet, isn't it curious that as much as we vexed about our place within the universe, paradoxically, we cherish its boundless mystery akin to the fathomless cosmos? It’s an uncanny surrender to this grand, profound enigma—the universe, our small part within. Ever-eluding us like waves reaching for the uncharted sea. As my beach ball rolled aimlessly, it's trajectory seemed arbitrary, reminiscent of our lives, subject to the whims of unseen hands. Nevertheless, the awe-forging specter of our dreams and aspirations finds a fleeting shelter much like the fate of the seaside ball. Both valiant attempts at imprints but deemed to ebb away in a tide of greater, indifferent phenomena. Yet, we persist, hopeful.

A sudden hush blanketed me. Perhaps, it was the cosmos, silently conversing using crickets' nocturnal serenades or meteoric metaphors etching paths across the black, daring me to elucidate destiny less riddled exogeneously. It was the immersive melody of this dance that I found freed. The universe, in its cryptic ambiguity, spoke to me without uttering a single word, in grains of sand falling onto the whispering sand or the moon’s luminous pull on the monsoon-drenched waves. Waves, nocturnal serenades, spectractors - they all murmured the hymn of existence, the responsive surrender that bolstered life's purpose. It's that continuous surrender, a willing embrace of uncertainty, that augured the dawn of resolve.

Eventually, with the final notes of wisdom carried away by the undulating sea breeze, I retreated from the beach into the horizon's embrace, my perspective subtly changed, my thoughts brimming with echoes of this primordial conversation. This poetic beach encounter had next-to-nothing to do directly with the course of my life. Instead, it was a moment of self-confrontation, a personal act of looking inward and marvelling at my existence. It rendered me liberated, unburdened and wonderfully humbled, whose echoes will persist long after the sun's rise. The world would spin, planets would orbit, ages would pass, and the beach would gradually morph into a memory, but the understanding of our place, both insignificant yet sacrosanct, would continue to thread my journey through time. Each day spawns a fresh tide, a new perspective, just as the sand is put back on shores anew, transparent brilliance that knows neither commencement nor end. We mould and shape our own narrative, in our unique grains of sand, amidst the constant flux of life's vast ocean. How gloriously riveting the dance of life, its perpetual narrative woven from an intricate snare of choice and chance, constantly continuing.
